input: books contains 1 through 1000 two-integer rows [thickness,height], with 1 <= thickness <= shelfWidth <= 1000 and 1 <= height <= 1000. Row aliases are allowed because all rows are read-only. Collections are ordinary finite dense arrays/lists, not subclasses, proxies, sparse/accessor-backed collections. Strings are ordinary/primitive strings. Every collection length and computed allocation size fits [0,4294967295], with padded sizes explicitly included. No concurrent mutation or built-in monkey-patching is allowed. Preconditions are not runtime-checked, and allocation/resource capacity or completion is not guaranteed by declared bounds. Python integer inputs are plain int, excluding bool.
return: Minimum total height for placing the books in their supplied order on shelves of width at most shelfWidth; each shelf contributes its tallest book height.
mutation_aliasing: Inputs and caller-held aliases remain unchanged; working state is private. The Solution instance retains no state.
numeric: All DP totals and candidate sums are at most n*1000 <= 1000000. The running width is at most shelfWidth+1000 before the breaking check. Each DP state considers every feasible final contiguous shelf and combines its maximum height with the already completed optimal prefix. All integer inputs/intermediates remain within [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: For n books: O(n*n) worst-case time and O(n+1) auxiliary storage. Backward scans include the first over-width book, and all DP allocation work is charged. Bounds include ordinary built-in operations/allocations and assume bounded-word arithmetic, constant-time indexing, amortized append/pop and any explicitly stated hash/sort behavior.
source_accounting: The complete standalone source is 580 UTF-8 bytes, including every helper, Solution wrapper, signature, loop, built-in call, annotation/comment, whitespace and terminal newline. Helpers are fully charged per candidate, not free shared libraries. No imports, runtime-generated implementations or hidden source expansion are used. Any eventual judge-interface adapter is additional charged source.
